ordered_parameters.name: inputs
ordered_parameters.type: nonempty list of scalar or rank-one Tensor

semantics.rust_signature: fn meshgrid_with_context_exact_native(backend: &CpuBackend, inputs: &[Tensor], indexing: MeshgridIndexing, context: &ExecutionContext<'_>) -> Result<Vec<Tensor>, ElementwiseRuntimeError>
semantics.mutation_rule: out of place; all inputs remain unchanged
semantics.alias_rule: one fresh canonical output storage is returned per input
semantics.shape_rule: ij output axes follow input order; xy swaps the first two output axes; scalars contribute length one and empty vectors produce empty grids
semantics.dtype_rule: all inputs and outputs share one canonical dtype
semantics.accumulation_dtype: VJP accumulation is f32 for the certified differentiable overload
semantics.device_rule: CPU ordinal zero is certified and all inputs must share stream
semantics.numeric_rule: each output broadcasts its corresponding input value over every other grid axis
semantics.tolerance: bit-exact element copying; f32 VJP uses fixed addition order
semantics.determinism: row-major traversal with explicit ij or xy mapping
semantics.cancellation_points: before validation, every bounded output traversal, during upload, and before publication
semantics.vjp_rule: each input gradient sums its corresponding output gradient over all broadcast axes
semantics.jvp_rule: input tangents use the identical meshgrid mapping
